_doc: This instance: the organisation whose content the built files carry (design note docs/reviews/2026-11-14-sheet-overlay-design.md v2, step 5; tools/instance.py). id: stable, never reused; name: the organisation's. centre (Pierre, 2026-11-13, Q339: the instance's central location made generic, should other organisations get instances of their own): the place the instance is about, the centre of its "near" area: presence near it (tools/presence.py NEAR_AREA, rule C8) and the default covers (a node's leaf most seen around it: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Fish content"); lat and lon in degrees, radiusKm the area's radius. Written into fish.json centre by tools/build_fish.py (every mode). key: the identification key in force at this deployment (the id of one of tools/fish_source.json keys, rule S3; tools/build_fish.py key_in_force reads it): the deployment's choice, not the organisation's content; absent, the region has no key and no group rule. layer: the instance's own content per subject (SUBJECTS key), laid on the sources at build (tools/instance.py: fish by tools/build_fish.py, coral and course, the lecture's photo records, by tools/datajson.py). Another organisation's instance sets its own; the tools that still hard-wire Dauin's area: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "The instance's centre".
name: Institute for Marine Research
